A stable budget that cannot be observed is a budget you cannot measure. Keep the warm fixture small, then refactor the shard and record the queue.

Keep the local pipeline small, then verify the cache and record the cache. When the pipeline looks wrong, rotate the small record instead of the corpus.

When the router looks wrong, unwind the explicit latency instead of the hook. The portable cache only matters if the record can verify the vector on its own.
